title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 99
paragraphs: Having set these things in order and strengthened himself in his despotism, he was strict in preserving justice. The people used to write down their cases and send them in to his presence, and he determined the questions that were brought in to him and sent them out again. Such was his manner with the judgment of cases. He also took order for this, namely, that if he heard that anyone was behaving in an unruly manner, he would send for him and punish him as each act of wrong deserved. And he had watchers and listeners throughout all the land over which he ruled.
